resolution.note: krn dispatch scopes gh to the cwd origin when no KRN_APP_REPOSITORY is set; the ship runner, lane status and lane-run CI logs scope gh to their root's origin. Live publish from the pilot root follows the merge.

title: krn verbs on an outside root give gh the origin's App repository
body:
Evidence 2026-11-18: from the pilot root /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead (origin krn-works/seo-audit-harness, a private repo), with scripts/app-bin/gh on PATH but no KRN_APP_REPOSITORY in the environment, `krn task publish` exited 70 with 'gh: Not Found (HTTP 404)', and `krn lane status` printed 'gh could not list pull requests' (.krn/runs/pilot/lanes/preflight-proof.log). evals/adoption/recovery-live.ts passed only because it sets that env itself. #1386 fixed the same class for doctor and src/repo/gh.ts only.
Outcome: every krn verb run from a root whose origin is a GitHub repository other than krn-works/krn gives gh that repository's KRN_APP_REPOSITORY, so task publish and lane status from the pilot root exit 0 with no caller env.
Proof: a test runs krn task publish against a fake gh that fails unless KRN_APP_REPOSITORY names the origin repository, and asserts exit 0. Live: `cd /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead && krn task publish` exits 0 and the ten preflight-note records reach origin/main.
Files: src/cli/, src/repo/gh.ts, src/task/
